lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, forming at least five distinct horizontal trajectories.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot patterns, particularly visible in the region posterior to the pectoral fin, forming a checkerboard-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to a shadow-defined lower boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-14 discrete high-luminance blobs, distributed with higher density near the base and posterior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (consistent with remoras) are visible in close proximity to the ventral side of the pectoral fin and lower flank.
